name: Ami Bera
stance: A co-leader on international AI-safety diplomacy — shared safety standards and red lines with China and a crisis-communications channel.

statements.text: Co-led a letter of 26 Democrats urging AI-safety diplomacy with China — shared safety standards and red lines, a crisis channel, and limits on proliferation of advanced AI, citing catastrophic risks like AI-enabled pathogens and cyberattacks.

review.note: added October 2026; record verified via the co-leads' primary release
